About Us

Business consulting with a view of the bigger picture.

We believe sustainable business development is achieved when people, processes, sales and organisation work together effectively.

Request a consultation

A practical approach to consulting

ConsultAxis stands for a practical approach to business consulting. We help businesses assess challenges in a structured way, review existing workflows and identify practical opportunities for improvement.

We see consulting as more than analysis. Our aim is to develop practical perspectives together with our clients and support sustainable improvements.

With Real Estate Consulting, we apply the same structured approach to property-related decisions of private and business clients.

ConsultAxis

We analyse. We optimise. We help businesses grow.

What our name stands for

ConsultAxis represents the different axes of business success: people, sales, organisation, processes, profitability and business development. We look at each axis, and at how they interact.

What you can expect

Practical
Recommendations that fit your business and can be implemented with the resources you have.
Structured
A clear process from the first conversation to the review of results, with objectives defined at the start.
Clear about limits
We say what lies outside our scope. Legal advice, tax advice and other regulated services are provided only by authorised specialists.

How we work

  1. 01

    Initial discussion and objectives

    We get to know your business and understand its challenges.

  2. 02

    Assessment of the current situation

    We review existing structures, workflows and relevant performance indicators.

  3. 03

    Development of an action plan

    We prepare tailored recommendations and practical measures.

  4. 04

    Implementation and support

    We assist with the agreed implementation activities.

  5. 05

    Review and continuous improvement

    We assess progress against the objectives and indicators defined at the start.

Let’s talk about your business.

Would you like to improve your operational workflows, optimise your sales structures, prepare a property decision or unlock new business opportunities? We look forward to learning about your situation.
